sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hts_contact_tracing a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE
  a.encounter_date >= :startDate
  AND a.encounter_date < :endDate
  AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  AND a.hiv_test_results IS NOT NULL
  AND a.contact_notification_method IS NOT NULL
  AND a.contact_notification_method LIKE '%SNS%'
;
